newsitem.title: UK: ScotAm says wants firm offers by February 28.
newsitem.headline: ScotAm says wants firm offers by February 28.

text.p: Scottish Amicable said on Thursday that all bidders for the mutually-owned insurance group will be requested to table firm offers by February 28.

Following the receipt of the proposals, ScotAm will hold further discussions with bidders after which they will be required to submit final binding proposals. The deadline for that is expected to be mid-March.
ScotAm said the board was concerned to ensure that the bidding process was final and that it would recommend a single proposal.
Under confidentiality agreements signed with potential bidders, the board's decision must be accepted as final.
"We believe the process we are publishing today will maximise value for policyholders and will be seen to have done so," said ScotAm chairman Sandy Stewart.
An announcement on the recommended acquirer is expected to be made by the end of March and the circular to policyholders explaining the board's decision is likely to be released in May.
